turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Hello! I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, plus the new delivery address.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Your order SC-3360 has already shipped. The address can only be changed before shipping, so I can't change it myself. I've passed your request, with the new address Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu, to a colleague. They will take over and decide what is possible.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer (nora.blake@example.com) wants to change the delivery address on SC-3360 to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Policy check says the order has already shipped, so the change is not allowed automatically. A person must decide.
